assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square original card portrait for a painted fantasy strategy game
Primary request: An original portrait of the Duskwing Trio, exactly three woodland creatures with an unusual owl-and-moth character.
Scene/backdrop: A quiet twilight woodland hollow with soft reed silhouettes, faint distant workshop copper roofs, and a few tiny emberseed lights.
Subject: Exactly three small, original owl-moth creatures gathered together, each with a distinct pose and readable body outline. Give them rounded feathered owl torsos, soft moth-like fringed wings, broad expressive amber eyes, short hooked beaks, and delicate feather tufts; blend these traits into a new woodland species rather than a familiar pet design. One perches forward on a branch, one opens its patterned wings, and one peers from behind a reed bundle. Use charcoal and warm gray feathers, muted reed-brown wing patterns, restrained copper markings, and a few ember-orange accents. Their wings are organic and softly scalloped, never stone or batlike.
Style/medium: Original hand-painted fantasy card illustration with controlled brushwork, matte feather and wing surfaces, softly sculpted forms, and warm atmospheric depth.
Composition/framing: Square close group portrait; exactly three creatures, all three faces visible, include their wing shapes without cropping, clustered as a clear trio and readable at small card-thumbnail size.
Lighting/mood: Gentle twilight with warm emberseed pinpoints and a subtle copper reflection from far-off workshops; curious, quiet, and alert.
Color palette: Charcoal, ash gray, reed tan, aged copper, and small ember-orange highlights.
Materials/textures: Soft layered feathers, fine moth-wing fringe and eye-like markings, woven reeds, muted woodland background.
Text (verbatim): None.
Constraints: Exactly three original owl-moth woodland creatures; maintain charcoal, reed, copper, and ember accents. No symbols, captions, letters, UI, frame, border, watermark, or logos.
Avoid: Any copied commercial-game character or recognizable design; blue gargoyles; blue skin; stone bodies; bat wings; horns; armor; extra animals or figures; big sharp teeth; photorealism; glossy 3D plastic; flat vector art; text.
